dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: I dare not even think of it. When the storm came, a huge rock came hurtling towards me. Fortunately, it missed, smashing into the ground next to me.

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: At that instant, all I could think about was my girlfriend. That was when I realized that she means the world to me.

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: Even if my father opposes us being together and tries to meddle in our affairs, our relationship will survive!

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: Yes. We will be together. I just... need some time to persuade my father...
